dcat_keyword_sm: A city that is green and resilient
dct_description_sm:
Identifies 123 former landfills through the City of Ottawa’s Old Landfill Management Strategy (OLMS 2004). Includes location, ownership, periods of operation and waste type for 82 sites identified as previously owned/operated either fully or in part by former municipalities and townships within the boundaries of the City of Ottawa.

Accuracy: Some footprints are only accurate to the OLMS 2004 report. For clarification contact the City’s Environmental Remediation Unit in the Corporate Real Estate Office at ERU@ottawa.ca.

Update Frequency: Last updated in 2017; and is updated as needed

Attributes: Includes Name, Site ID, Operational Period, Owner, Owner Category. Some information also exists for adjacent land uses, groundwater flow direction and depth of waste, but not available for all entries.

Contact: Environmental Remediation Unit, Corporate Real Estate Office
